name: RCA CTDPFA salinity calibration, Cabled-15 AT50-29 (2024)

annotations.annotation: No comms with SF03A node controller; all pod instruments except PCO2W initially started up, but were no longer reporting until the node controller was swapped (pressure housing had flooded). After initial power up, several instruments were not reporting and digis were not responding to pings; a known DSL modem issue with this node controller that was fixed with a power cycle of SF03A. All instruments are operational.

rca:flags.text: Reference .cnv was processed with datcnv only; alignctd / celltm / loopedit are not applied.

The .cnv holds the downcast only (15964 scans, 14316 kept after removing ship-heave reversals). Bottle (.btl) averages are taken at upcast bottle closures, so CTD-vs-Autosal uses upcast data while profiler-vs-CTD uses the downcast.
Niskin 23 (SA-65, ~10 m depSM, sal00): CTD-bottle -0.0078 PSU is more than 0.01 PSU from the median; CTD gradient there +0.000 PSU/m.
Niskin 23 (SA-65, ~10 m depSM, sal11): CTD-bottle -0.0078 PSU is more than 0.01 PSU from the median; CTD gradient there +0.000 PSU/m.
Autosal workbook header date is 2025-04-19 but the cast is on 2024-08-12; looks like a template leftover (not changed).
